content: मेधा [मेध्-अञ्] (changed to मेधस् in <ab>Bah. comp.</ab> when preceded by सु, दुस् and the negative particle अ) .²1 Retentive faculty, retentiveness (of memory); धीर्धारणावती मेधा <ls>Ak.</ls> .²2 Intellect, intelligence in general; यत् सप्तान्नानि मेधया तपसाजनयत् पिता <ls>Bṛ. Up. 1. 5. 1</ls>; <ls>Bg. 10. 34</ls>; आयुष्मन्तं सुतं सूते यशोमेधासमन्वितम् <ls>Ms. 3. 263</ls>; <ls>Y. 3. 173</ls>. .²3 A form of Sarasvatī. .²4 A sacrifice. .²5 Strength, power (<ab>Ved.</ab>).
